data.name: Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition
data.detailed_description:
The Legendary RPG Returns

Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition brings back the chilling, atmospheric adventure that defined a generation of classic cRPGs. Originally released in 2000, this is the Dungeons & Dragons journey that led countless players into the frozen North—now thoughtfully refined for modern adventurers while preserving every bit of its old‑school charm.

Customize a full party of up to six heroes and brave the icy wilderness of the Spine of the World, battling fearsome monsters, delving into ancient dungeons, and uncovering the long‑buried secrets hidden beneath the snow.

Original Campaigns & Unseen Quests

Experience the full breadth of the original 2000 adventure, including the base campaign, both official expansions, and restored quests that were left on the cutting‑room floor. It’s the most complete version of the classic ever assembled.

  • Original Icewind Dale Campaign

  • Heart of Winter Expansion

  • Trials of the Luremaster Expansion

Customize Your Party

Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition preserves the deep party‑building that made the original a standout among classic cRPGs. Shape a full adventuring company with expanded class options, new spells, and powerful gear to help you survive the frozen North.

  • Expanded Class Options: Over 30 new character kits and adventuring classes

  • Carry Over Your Heroes: Upload characters from previous playthroughs

  • New Spells & Gear: Dozens of additional abilities and items to strengthen your party

  • New Magical Equipment: Fresh armor and weaponry to aid you in the harsh surroundings

Classic Gameplay

  • 2D Isometric Graphics: The timeless perspective of classic cRPGs

  • Real‑Time‑with‑Pause Combat: Strategic encounters with old‑school pacing

  • 2nd Edition AD&D Rules: Faithfully adapted for authentic Dungeons & Dragons play

Enhanced for Modern Adventurers

Thoughtful refinements make the classic smoother to play today, while preserving its unmistakable atmosphere.

  • Updated Interface: Includes a new quick‑loot bar for easier exploration

  • Polished Experience: Scores of bug fixes and improvements to the original game

  • Cross‑Platform Multiplayer: Adventure together across Windows, macOS, Linux, Android, and iOS

Evil Stirs in the Frozen North

Far beyond the warmth of civilization lies Icewind Dale, a stark and unforgiving stretch of land where only the hardiest souls endure. Journey deep into the Spine of the World, a land of snow‑shrouded peaks and ancient dangers, where beasts grow cunning to survive the endless winter.

Beneath the carved glaciers, a sinister force gathers strength—an evil whose schemes threaten to spill destruction across the face of Faerûn. This is the world of Icewind Dale: Enhanced Edition, a classic Dungeons & Dragons adventure reborn for a new age of heroes.

reviews.review:
Short Version: 
Had you ever thought of playing the source material of many 
isekai anime? and just realiced you don't have a high specs
computer. Well fear not, this game is the answer.

The gameplay isn't for everyone, pressing 'SpaceBar' is the way to go
if you loved Baldur's Gate 3, you should consider giving this game a chance
just because of the amazing story Narrator.

The gameplay is a combination of Real Time Strategy (RTS) and Turn Based (Table Top),
if you played Diablo 1 or 2, you should feel something similar but with 6 custom party members.
The game uses a rule set called 2nd version of D&D unlike BG3 with the 5th version.
Some spell and weapon limitations are diferent or dosen't exist at all, be wary of it.

The party you form at the start is the one you will need use to finish the game,
no other party memeber can be added while playing and their skill points are set in stone.

Class compositions and synergy are key to beat the game, intimidating but the game already
made some preset characters and class combinations if you don't want to stress over it.
On a personal note, I cleared the game & the 2 expasions using this party compasition:

Tank: Blackguard (Paladin)
Healer: Priest of Lathander (Cleric) & Totemic Druid (Druid)
Trap Detector / Melee DPS: Swashbuckler (Thief)
Ranged DPS: Archer (Ranger)
FIRE Crowd Control: Mage

NOte: There are a LOT of enemies with an annoying trait of being unable
to die until you damage them with a FIRE attack. Mage is a good source of Fire Damage.

Played this game using custom portraits, you can get one to the right size using this link:
http://www.notra.fr/
The path to paste them on your game should be like this, create the 'Portraits' folder if it doesn't exist:
C:\Users\[Your Username]\Documents\Icewind Dale - Enhanced Edition\Portraits

Note: as for 2.7 version of the game, custom voice-overs are a nightmare to install.
A real shame they broke a community tool that used to allow a simple instalation.
The console commands are still allowed to be used and if you mess up the
expansion clear order, your only option is to use the console to access the 'LureMaster' Expansion.

To enable console commands modify this file with a text editor:
C:\Users\[Your Username]\Documents\Icewind Dale - Enhanced Edition\Baldur.lua
Search for lines with a 'Program Options' and add this LINE after the last configuration of that type:
SetPrivateProfileString('Program Options','Debug Mode','1')

After you save the changes to the file, you can start up your game and it will be enabled it when
you press this keyboard combination 'Ctrl + SpaceBar', I used it as a way for fast travel, here are some examples:

Travel to Expasion Town:
CLUAConsole:MoveToArea("AR9100")

Return to Base Game:
CLUAConsole:MoveToArea("AR2100")

More commands at: 
https://forums.beamdog.com/discussion/43046/icewind-dale-enhanced-edition-clua-console-commands-and-areas

If you want to avoid using the console like i did, you could use a guide with the
recommended progresion, found this one that still works:
 https://gamefaqs.gamespot.com/android/874368-icewind-dale-enhanced-edition/faqs/78382/chapter-1

I started the 'Heart of Winter' Expansion after finishing 'Chapter 3', 
I mess up by finishing that expansion 'main story' and was locked
from starting 'Trials of the Luremaster' Expansion, had to use the 
'console commands' to return to Loneywood and talk to the tavern NPC.

By that way I was able to enjoy using the best armor in the game, 
also cursing the fact that some 'undead castle guards' were
killing me while i was wearing said armor. 
Definitely 'Trials of the Luremaster' Expansion is the real Chapter 7 or Endgame.

To be honest I enjoyed this game because of the full customizable party from the start and the
dungeons in each chapter have great field designs that are hard to replicate in modern RPGs

This gem has a timeless magic that makes you forget that the graphics are outdated,
but that also means you can play it on almost play it on
any kind of Computer without overwhelming requirements.
